title: Substation Control Panel Upgrade
short: PLC-based control panel retrofit for a Copperbelt mining site.
full: Designed and installed a new PLC-based control and protection panel for a substation on a Copperbelt mining site, replacing aging relay logic with a modern, monitored control system to improve reliability and reduce downtime.

title: Warehouse Solar Hybrid System
short: Rooftop solar and battery hybrid system for a logistics warehouse.
full: Designed and installed a rooftop solar PV and battery hybrid system for a logistics warehouse, cutting grid dependence and providing backup power during outages, with remote monitoring for performance tracking.

title: Corporate Campus CCTV & Access Control
short: Multi-building surveillance and access control network.
full: Deployed an integrated CCTV and access control network across a multi-building corporate campus, including structured cabling, centralized video management, and card-based access control at key entry points.

title: SCADA Integration for Water Treatment
short: Remote monitoring of pumps and valves at a treatment plant.
full: Integrated a SCADA monitoring layer over existing pump and valve control systems at a water treatment facility, giving operators real-time visibility and alarms from a central control room.

title: Structured Network Rollout
short: Office fibre and LAN backbone for a regional distributor.
full: Rolled out a structured fibre and LAN backbone for a regional distributor's head office, including switch configuration, wireless coverage, and a hardened network setup to support growing IT needs.

title: Conveyor Motor Control Retrofit
short: VFD retrofit reducing energy usage at a processing plant.
full: Retrofitted conveyor motor control with variable frequency drives at a processing plant, reducing energy consumption and mechanical wear while improving start-up control and fault diagnostics.

title: Residential Rewiring & Distribution Upgrade
short: Full rewire and distribution board upgrade for a family home.
full: Carried out a complete rewiring and distribution board upgrade for a residential property, including new lighting and power circuits, safety earthing, and a full electrical inspection and compliance certificate.

title: Solar Borehole Pumping System
short: Solar-powered borehole pump installation for a rural facility.
full: Installed a solar-powered borehole pumping system to supply reliable water for a rural facility, including pump sizing, solar array installation, and integration with an elevated storage tank.

title: Corporate Website & Company Profile Platform
short: Company profile website with an integrated careers and portfolio system.
full: Designed and built a company profile website with dynamic careers and portfolio sections, allowing the client to update open positions and project case studies without touching the site's code.

title: Corporate Brand Identity Package
short: Logo, stationery, and branded workwear for a growing SME.
full: Developed a full corporate identity package for a growing SME, including logo design, business cards, letterheads, social media templates, and branded workwear for field staff.
